guide_notes_p1: Khetha noma yimuphi umbhalo ukuze usebenzise okugqamile noma okutshekile kubha yamathuluzi — ungahlanganisa kokubili egameni elifanayo.
guide_notes_p2: Namathisela izithombe kusuka kugalari yakho noma ikhamera ngokuqondile ngaphakathi kwenothi; izithombe zigcinwa endaweni futhi zihlale zibethelwe.
guide_notes_p3: Phina inothi ukuze uligcine phezulu ohlwini lwakho — thepha imenyu ye-⋮ noma cindezela isikhathi eside ikhadi ukuze uphine noma ungaphethi.
guide_checklist_p1: Thepha ibhokisi lokuhlola ukuze umake into njengeqediwe; thepha isithonjana sokuhlunga ukuze ushintshe phakathi: Okusalindile kuqala, Okuqediwe kuqala, noma ukuhlunga kuka-A→Z.
guide_checklist_p2: Swayiphela kwesokunxele emugqeni ukuze ususe ngokushesha. Ukubuka okuhlangene kukhombisa into ngayinye emugqeni owodwa.
guide_checklist_p3: Ikhadi lenothi likhombisa inani eliphelele lezinto nokuthi mangaki aseqediwe — ukubuka ngokushesha kwenqubekelaphambili ngaphandle kokuvula inothi.
guide_itinerary_p1: Ukungena ngakunye kwendawo okuyiwa kuyo kunegama lendawo, isikhathi sokufika, isikhathi sokuhamba, nenkundla yamanothi yezinkomba zokubhukha noma izinkomba.
guide_itinerary_p2: Thepha isiphunzi sosuku noma sesikhathi kunoma yikuphi ukungena ukuze uvule isikhethi futhi uhlele kabusha — okungenayo kuhlala ngokulandelana kwezikhathi ngokuzenzakalelayo.
guide_itinerary_p3: Ikhadi lenothi likhombisa ukubuka kuqala kwenani eliphelele lezindawo okuyiwa kuzo ukuze ubone ububanzi bohambo lwakho shwaka.
guide_meal_plan_p1: Umugqa wosuku ngalunye unezikhala zesidlo sasekuseni, sasemini, sasihlwa, nokudla okulula — shiya izikhala zingenalutho noma ususe uma kungadingeki. Engeza imigqa njengoba kudingeka.
guide_meal_plan_p2: Thepha isikhala sokudla ukuze uthayiphe igama lesidlo noma ungeze amanothi asheshayo afana nezikhumbuzo zokulungiselela; izinguquko zigcinwa ngokuzenzakalelayo.
guide_meal_plan_p3: Ikhadi lenothi likhombisa ukuthi mangaki izinsuku ezihleliwe, okuhlinzeka ngesifinyezo esisheshayo ngaphandle kokuvula inothi eligcwele.
guide_recipe_p1: Setha isikhathi sokulungiselela, isikhathi sokupheka, nenani elikhonzayo phezulu — izikhonzayo zivela ekhadini lenothi ukuze uthole ireferensi esheshayo.
guide_recipe_p2: Engeza izithako negama nobuningi; hudula isibambo kumugqa noma yimuphi ukuze uhlele kabusha ngaphandle kokususa nokwengeza futhi.
guide_recipe_p3: Izinyathelo zibalwa ngokuzenzakalelayo — faka isinyathelo noma kuphi ohlwini futhi ukubala kuzozivuselela.
guide_drawing_p1: Khetha Ipeni, I-Highlighter, noma I-Eraser kubha yamathuluzi engezansi; lungisa umbala womugqa nobukhulu ngaphambi kokudweba.
guide_drawing_p2: Hlehlisa futhi wenze kabusha unhlangothi ngalunye ngokwehlukile ngezinkinobho ze-↩ / ↪ — bamba noma iyiphi inkinobho ukuze udabule umlando ngokushesha.
guide_drawing_p3: Thepha okuthi Thumela Isithombe kubha yamathuluzi ukuze ulondoloze umdwebo wakho kugalari yedivayisi njengesithombe se-PNG esinosayizi ogcwele.
guide_security_p1: Wonke amanothi ajwayelekile nemidwebo kubethelwe nge-AES-256 kusetshenziswa ukhiye othathwe kwiphasiwedi yakho eyinhloko — akufundeki ngaphandle kwayo.
guide_security_p2: Ngemva kokuvula ngempumelelo okokuqala, vula i-biometrics kuzilungiselelo ukuze uthole ukufinyelela okusheshayo ngeminwe noma ubuso.
guide_security_p3: Isithonjana esiluhlaza 🔒 ekhadini lenothi sisho ukuthi sibethelwe ngephasiwedi eyinhloko yamanje. Isithonjana sikhiye esiwolintshi sisho ukuthi sibethelwe ngephasiwedi eyinhloko ehlukile — faka iphasiwedi yokuqala ukuze usifunde.
guide_sync_p1: Ngena ngemvume nge-Google ngaphansi kwezilungiselelo → I-akhawunti; thepha Layisha noma Buyisela ukuze uthumele noma uthole idatha — sebenzisa i-akhawunti efanayo kudivayisi ngayinye.
guide_sync_p2: Ngemva kokufaka kabusha, ngena ngemvume bese uthepha Buyisela kusuka ku-Drive — uhlelo lokusebenza luthatha usawoti wakho wokubethela ukuze wonke amanothi abethelwe ngendlela efanele.
guide_sync_p3: Lapho inothi elifanayo lihlelwa kumadivayisi amabili, ukungqubuzana kumakwa ukuze ukwazi ukukhetha Gcina Okwendawo, Gcina Okukude, noma Gcina Kokubili.
guide_controls_p1: Thepha ikhadi lenothi ukuze ulivule; cindezela isikhathi eside noma yiliphi ikhadi ukuze ufake imodi yokukhetha eminingi — bese uthepha amakhadi amaningi ukuze uwengeze ekukhetheni.
guide_controls_p2: Swayiphela ikhadi kwesokunxele ukuze ususe. Ngaphakathi kwenothi, thepha ⋮ ukuze uphine, ushintshe umbala, ushintshe isigaba, ungeze isithombe, noma ususe inothi.
guide_controls_p3: Thepha isithonjana seso 👁 ekhadini noma yini ukuze ubuke kuqala inothi ngaphandle kokuvula umhleli — kuwusizo ekufundeni okusheshayo ngaphandle kokushiya uhlu.
guide_organisation_p1: Thepha isithonjana sokusesha 🔍 kubha ephezulu ukuze useshe kuzo zonke izinhlobo zamanothi — imiphumela ihambisana nezihloko, umbhalo womzimba, izinto zohlu lokuhlola, izindawo oya kuzo, okungenayo kokudla, nezithako zeresiphi kanyekanye.
guide_organisation_p2: Thepha isithonjana sokuhlunga ukuze ushintshe phakathi: Okusha kuqala, Okudala kuqala, noma ukubuka kwesigaba — ekubukweni kwesigaba iqembu ngalinye (Okujwayelekile, Umsebenzi, Okwakho, Imibono) lingagoqwa.
guide_organisation_p3: Nika isigaba kunothi noma yini ngaphakathi komhleli usebenzisa umugqa wama-chips ngaphansi kwesihloko; nika umbala usebenzisa ⋮ → Shintsha Umbala ukuze uhlukanise amanothi ngokubukeka shwaka.
faq_lock_icon_q: Kungani inothi lami likhombisa isithonjana sikhiye esiwolintshi nomlayezo wephasiwedi ohlukile?
faq_lock_icon_a: Isithonjana sikhiye esiwolintshi sisho ukuthi inothi libethelwe ngephasiwedi eyinhloko ehlukile kunaleyo elayishwe njengamanje. Lokhu kwenzeka ngokuvamile ngemva kokufaka kabusha uhlelo lokusebenza nokudala iphasiwedi entsha eyinhloko. Faka iphasiwedi yokuqala esetshenziswe lapho inothi lenziwa ukuze ufinyelele kulo.
faq_forgot_password_q: Kwenzekani uma ngikhohlwa iphasiwedi yami eyinhloko?
faq_forgot_password_a: Amanothi abethelwe end-to-end nge-AES-256 futhi iphasiwedi ayikwazi ukubuyiselwa yinoma ubani — kubandakanya unjiniyela. Uma unokulondoloza kwe-Google Drive okwenziwe lapho usayazi iphasiwedi, kubuyisele bese ufaka iphasiwedi efanele. Ngaphandle kwephasiwedi yokuqala, amanothi abethelwe awakwazi ukufinyelelwa. Lokhu kwenzelwe ukubavikela ubumfihlo bakho.
faq_sync_devices_q: Ngalivula njani ukuvumelanisa amanothi phakathi kwamadivayisi?
faq_sync_devices_a: Iya kuzilungiselelo → I-akhawunti bese ungena nge-akhawunti efanayo ye-Google kudivayisi ngayinye. Thepha Vumelanisa Manje ukuze ulayishe noma ulande. Ngemva kokufaka kabusha kudivayisi entsha, ngena ngemvume kuqala bese uthepha Buyisela kusuka ku-Drive — uhlelo lokusebenza luthatha usawoti wakho wokubethela ukuze iphasiwedi yakho eyinhloko ikwazi ukubethela yonke into ngendlela efanele.
faq_notes_missing_q: Kungani amanothi ami engaveli ngemva kokufaka kabusha?
faq_notes_missing_a: Amanothi endawo agcinwa kudivayisi futhi ayasuswa uma ukhipha uhlelo lokusebenza. Uma ukuvumelanisa kwe-Drive bekunikwe amandla, ngena ngemvume futhi ngaphansi kwezilungiselelo → I-akhawunti bese uthepha Buyisela kusuka ku-Drive. Uma uthekelise isipele se-JSON nge-Izilungiselelo → Isitoreji → Landa Amanothi JSON, thepha Layisha Amanothi JSON ukuze uwangenise futhi.
faq_no_account_a: Yebo — zonke izinhlobo eziyisithupha zamanothi (Inothi, Uhlu lokuhlola, Uhlelo lohambo, Uhlelo lokudla, Iresiphi, Ukudweba) zisebenza ngokupheleleyo ungaxhunyiwe ku-inthanethi ngaphandle kwesidingo se-akhawunti. Amanothi agcinwa futhi abethelwe kudivayisi. I-akhawunti idingeka kuphela uma ufuna ukuvumelanisa kwe-Google Drive noma ukulondoloza phakathi kwamadivayisi.
faq_export_backup_q: Ngalikhipha njani noma ngilondoloze amanothi ami?
faq_export_backup_a: Lesi sici okwamanje sitholakala kuphela kubasebenzisi be-Google Sync. Iya kuzilungiselelo → Isitoreji bese uthepha Landa Amanothi JSON ukuze ulondoloze ifayela lokulondoloza elibethelwe kudivayisi yakho. Ukuze ubuyisele, thepha Layisha Amanothi JSON bese ukhetha lelo fayela. Amanothi ahlala ebethelwe ngaphakathi kwefayela, ngakho-ke ukulondoloza kuphephile ukugcinwa noma kuphi.
faq_canvas_preview_q: Kungani ilaphu libukeka lihlukile ekubukeni kuqala kohlu?
faq_canvas_preview_a: Ikhadi lenothi libonisa isithombe esincane selaphu lakho ngenxa yokusebenza. Umdwebo wosayizi ogcwele uhlala ugcinwa — thepha inothi ukuze ulivule ngosayizi ogcwele. Isithombe esincane siyavuselela njalo uma ulondoloza.
faq_biometrics_a: Ngemva kokufaka iphasiwedi yakho eyinhloko ngokufanele okokuqala, ungabhalisa i-biometrics kuzilungiselelo. Ekulandeleni ukuqalisa, ukwaziswa komunwe noma ubuso kuvela ngokuzenzakalelayo. Uma ukuqinisekiswa kwe-biometric kwehluleka noma kukhanselwa, uhlelo lokusebenza lubuyela esikrinini sephasiwedi eyinhloko.
faq_reorder_checklist_q: Ngingakwazi ukuhlela kabusha noma ukuhlunga izinto zohlu lokuhlola?
faq_reorder_checklist_a: Yebo. Ngaphakathi kwenothi lohlu lokuhlola, thepha isithonjana sokuhlunga kubha yamathuluzi ukuze ushintshe phakathi koku: ukuhlela ngesandla, A→Z, Z→A, Okusalindile kuqala, noma Okuqediwe kuqala. Ungaphinda uhudule noma yini into ngesiphatho sayo ukuze uyibeke kanye lapho ufuna khona — imodi yakho yokuhlunga ekhethiweyo iyakhunjulwa kwinothi ngalinye.
faq_delete_note_a: Swayiphela ikhadi lenothi kwesokunxele ukuze uveze inketho yokususa, noma cindezela isikhathi eside ukuze ufake imodi yokukhetha eminingi futhi ususe amanothi amaningi ngesikhathi esisodwa. Amanothi asusiwe aya ku-Bin Yokulahlwa — vula Izilungiselelo → I-Bin Yokulahlwa ukuze ubuyisele noma ususe ngonaphakade.
faq_recover_note_a: Yebo. Amanothi asusiwe awakaze asuswe ngokushesha — aya ku-Bin Yokulahlwa kuqala. Vula Izilungiselelo → I-Bin Yokulahlwa, thola inothi lakho, bese uthepha Buyisela ukuze ulibuyise. Amanothi ashiya i-Bin Yokulahlwa ngonaphakade kuphela uma uthepha i-Bin Yokulahlwa Engenalutho, ngakho-ke unesikhathi esiningi sokulungisa iphutha.
faq_share_note_a: Cindezela inothi isikhathi eside bese uthepha isithonjana Sokwabelana ukuze ulithumele njengombhalo ocacile. Okuqukethwe kufomethwa ngohlobo — izinto zohlu lokuhlola zifaka isimo sazo sokumaka, izindlela zokupheka zifaka izithako nezinyathelo, izinhlelo zohambo zikhombisa indawo ngayinye enosuku nesikhathi. Ukuze wabelane ngamanothi amaningi ngesikhathi esisodwa, cindezela ikhadi isikhathi eside ukuze ufake imodi yokukhetha eminingi, khetha inani olidingayo, bese uthepha isithonjana sokwabelana kubha ephezulu.
faq_change_colour_a: Vula inothi bese uthepha ⋮ → Shintsha Umbala ukuze ukhethe ezindikimbeni zemibala etholakalayo (njenge-Sunset, Lavender, Rose, ne-Forest). Umbala okhethiweyo uvela njengomugqa wokugqamisa ekhadini lenothi ohlwini, okwenza kube lula ukuhlukanisa amanothi ngokubukeka shwaka. Umbala ungowe-note nganye futhi ungashintshwa noma nini.
